AI Compass

AI Lab: 13 free machine learning experiments in your browser

Real machine learning that runs in your browser. Pick an experiment, teach a model, test it and see where it fails.

✏️ Draw and teach

Teach the computer your own drawings, then test it on new ones.

What it shows: Training data and generalisation

🍇 Finding groups

Nobody tells the computer the answers. Watch k-means find the groups in a cloud of points by itself.

What it shows: Unsupervised learning: finding groups

🌳 Grow a decision tree

Ask yes/no questions to sort animals, then let the computer find the best questions itself.

What it shows: Decision trees and overfitting

📨 Build a spam filter

Teach a filter which words smell like spam, then try to sneak a message past it.

What it shows: Naive Bayes and false alarms

📺 Why your feed looks like that

Like a few videos and see how an app finds people like you, then watch a feed shrink into a bubble.

What it shows: Recommendations and filter bubbles

🧠 Teach the machine

Place dots, press Train, and watch a neural network learn to tell them apart.

What it shows: Neural networks

⛰️ Down the hill: gradient descent

Race three balls down a hill of error, and see why the size of each step decides everything.

What it shows: Gradient descent: how models learn

💬 Next-word predictor

Type a few words and see how a tiny language model guesses what comes next.

What it shows: Language models

🔍 Inside a chatbot

See what a chatbot does with your words: tokens, meanings, attention and weighted dice.

What it shows: Large language models

👁️ How computers see

Slide a 3 × 3 filter over a picture: it finds edges, blurs and sharpens. Then look through the eyes of a tiny neural network.

What it shows: Convolution: how computers find edges and shapes

🤖 Robot in a maze

Nobody shows the robot the way. Watch it learn from rewards and penalties.

What it shows: Reinforcement learning

🧬 Evolution garage

These cars start out crashing. Watch good driving evolve, generation after generation.

What it shows: Learning by evolution

⚖️ Bias detective

Twins with the same skill: one gets in, the other doesn't. Find out how an AI learned to be unfair.

What it shows: Bias and fairness

Every experiment runs in your browser. Free, no sign-up, nothing to install.
